thread:
Emily (Sales): Quick sync — QuantumBank wants delegated admin support in their SSO (so SAML assertion that maps to an admin role), SCIM provisioning with pretty aggressive rate limits (they've asked for 200 req/s during onboarding), and RBAC mapping. They also asked for pricing delta between Hosted vs Dedicated for that traffic profile. Can we outline a POC plan + answers for their security questionnaire?

Raj (Infra Eng): For delegated admin via SAML we support role assertions. Typical claim we consume is `role` or `groups`. Example SAML attribute we can map -> internal admin role:
```xml
<Attribute Name=\"https://redwood.ai/claims/role\">
  <AttributeValue>admin:tenant-123</AttributeValue>
</Attribute>
```
We can map prefix `admin:` to our `tenant_admin` RBAC role during assertion handling.

Maria (Security): Security Q highlights: 1) Proof of domain ownership — we accept DNS TXT or CNAME or an org-signed acct doc. 2) SCIM: we need to confirm SCIM push uses TLS 1.2+ and we support signed provisioning via client certs or token. We'll need to provide our standard questionnaire answers (I'll attach Confluence link in a sec).

Ben (Solutions): POC plan suggestion (2-week):
- Day 0: Exchange SAML metadata + SCIM endpoint + scopes
- Day 1-3: Run SAML test with 3 test users (one admin assertion)
- Day 4-7: SCIM bulk sync at low RPS to validate attribute -> RBAC mapping
- Day 8-9: Ramp SCIM to target (we'll emulate 200 rps) on Dedicated staging to validate throughput
- Day 10-14: Security questionnaire answers + runbook handed off
I'll own scheduling and test harness. Need QuantumBank to provide 2 SAML IdP test certs and SCIM token.

QuantumBank IT: Can confirm we can provide IdP test certs and a SCIM token. For domain proof we prefer DNS TXT. We do expect SCIM rate limits to apply network egress costs — any ballpark on price impact?

Raj (Infra Eng): Pricing note: Hosted cost = per-token/usage plus egress; high sustained SCIM at 200 rps for many minutes will push you toward Dedicated. For example, a Dedicated reserved pool to sustain 200 rps of provisioning traffic (short spikes) estimate: $Xk/mo committed (I'll send numbers to sales sheet). Advantages: predictable throughput, no throttling, private networking option (VPC). For POC we can run a short Dedicated trial or put you on a Hosted burst policy — tradeoffs explained in doc I'll link.

Maria (Security): SCIM rate limiting: we support configurable per-tenant rate limits. If they need 200 rps sustained, we prefer Dedicated. Also mandatory audit logs for provisioning actions, and we can push syslog events to their SIEM (Supports syslog/HTTP).

Raj (Infra Eng): Example SCIM rate-limit response we typically return when throttled:
```http
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 12
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:Error"],
  "detail": "Rate limit exceeded for tenant_id=qb-9876",
  "status": "429"
}
```
If they can accept an exponential backoff and retries, Hosted is possible; otherwise Dedicated.

Ben (Solutions): Action items: @Emily - confirm whether QuantumBank wants proof-of-concept on Hosted (fast) or Dedicated (real throughput). @Raj - can you drop rough dedicated pricing to the sales doc by EOD? @Maria - can you attach the security questionnaire answers + SCIM TLS/cert guidance?

Emily (Sales): I'll ask them which path they prefer. Also they asked about delegated admin granularity — can we support scoped admin per domain (not whole tenant)?

Raj (Infra Eng): Yes — our RBAC supports resource-scoped roles: `admin:domain:acme.example.com`. SAML assertion can include the domain claim and we'll map it accordingly. We'll need a mapping table for the POC.

Maria (Security): One more security note: If they want SCIM push from their IdP (Okta/AzureAD), ensure we exchange a client cert or rotateable bearer tokens. We'll provide the token rotation docs.

QuantumBank IT: Sounds good. We'll decide tonight between Hosted trial vs Dedicated trial and get you certs tomorrow. Also, can you confirm data residency for provisioning logs? We need EU-only storage for logs.

Raj (Infra Eng): We can route audit logs to EU-only storage for Dedicated or Hosted with log-routing addon. Marking this as a required compliance item for the POC.
